definitions.explanation: A striking difference between two things when compared side by side.
The act of comparing two things to find similarities or differences.

notes:
{対照|たいしょう} means contrast or comparison, emphasizing differences between two things placed side by side. As a noun it refers to the contrast itself; as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb it means to compare or collate.

COMMON FORMS:
- ⟦{対照的|たいしょうてき}→対照的：12369_taishouteki⟧ (na-adjective: contrastive, contrasting)
- {対照|たいしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to compare, to collate)
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{対照|たいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦なす→為す：03915_nasu⟧ (to form a contrast with ~)
- {対照|たいしょう}⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ (comparison table)

WATCH OUT:
{対照|たいしょう} (contrast) and ⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧ (target, object) are pronounced the same. Context usually makes the meaning clear, but learners should be careful in writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧: comparison (more general, can compare similar things)
- ⟦{対比|たいひ}→対比：12417_taihi⟧: comparison or contrast (similar to {対照|たいしょう} but less common)
- {対照|たいしょう}: emphasizes striking differences when placed side by side
